mapper.select: SELECT menu_id, parent_menu_id, code, name, type, route_name, route_path, icon, sort_order, status FROM squad_user.sq_menu ORDER BY sort_order, menu_id
SELECT code, name, menu_id, status, sort_order FROM squad_user.sq_permission ORDER BY sort_order, code

WITH RECURSIVE active_tree AS ( SELECT menu_id FROM squad_user.sq_menu WHERE parent_menu_id IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE' UNION ALL SELECT child.menu_id FROM squad_user.sq_menu child JOIN active_tree parent ON child.parent_menu_id = parent.menu_id WHERE child.status = 'ACTIVE' ), granted AS ( SELECT DISTINCT rm.role_id, rm.menu_id FROM squad_user.sq_user u JOIN squad_user.sq_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id AND ur.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN squad_user.sq_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.applied_version IS NOT NULL JOIN squad_user.sq_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = r.role_id AND rm.stage = 'APPLIED' WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.del_flag = '0' ), valid_tree AS ( SELECT g.role_id, m.menu_id FROM granted g JOIN squad_user.sq_menu m ON m.menu_id = g.menu_id WHERE m.parent_menu_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT g.role_id, m.menu_id FROM granted g JOIN squad_user.sq_menu m ON m.menu_id = g.menu_id JOIN valid_tree p ON p.role_id = g.role_id AND p.menu_id = m.parent_menu_id ) SELECT DISTINCT v.menu_id FROM valid_tree v JOIN active_tree a ON a.menu_id = v.menu_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM squad_user.sq_role_menu WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND stage = #{stage}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO squad_user.sq_role_menu (role_id, menu_id, stage, creator_id, last_updater_id) VALUES
(#{roleId}, #{id}, #{stage}, #{actor}, #{actor})
